hf_private_backup.checkpoint_resume_scope_correction: The original scope sentence is inaccurate for the private encoder files: run_encoders copies the custom _fit payload, including optimizer, CPU torch RNG, Python RNG and step, into its final vision.pt/audio.pt. These custom files are not native CLI resume checkpoints, and they omit CUDA RNG state. Simple-v1 files are weights/vocabulary only. Public inference exports remove optimizer and RNG state. Full-directory backup alone does not establish exact resumed training.
